RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

At 11 a.m. 23/12/39, a telephone message was received at this station from the Japanese Naval Court-Martial, No.80 Hannen Road, expressing their wish to hand over to the S.M.P. of 8 male Chinese under their custody on suspicion of pocket-picking cases in the International Settlement.

On being notified of the above message, Sen.Det. C/I Telfer detailed the undersigned who placed them in his custody at the court, and brought to the Hongkew Station namely :-

1st. Tse Ah Moh (謝阿毛), age 28, Soochow, M/unemployed, 72 Rue Montmorand, F.C.
2nd. Zee Ong Sung (徐永生), age 19, Soochow, S/unemployed, F.C.
3rd. Kwong Chai Kong (韓才根), 40, Woosung, M/unemployed, F.C.
4th. Wong Yoong Shih (黃榮熙), 36, Honan, M/unemployed, F.C.
5th. Wong Tsung Kong (王長根), 39, Kiangsu, M/unemployed, 13 Thorburn Li, Thorburn Rd.
6th. Yang Kying Sung (楊金生), 20, Hopei, S/unemployed, F.C.
7th. Song Yon Ling (宋玉林), 19, Zaushing, S/unemployed, F.C.
8th. Sung Kong Yung (孫國榮), 16, Zangchow, S/unemployed, 12 Thorburn Road.

Enquiries conducted by D.S. Ueoka, C.D.S.171 and the undersigned.

1939年12月23日上午11时，本捕房接到来自汉密尔顿路80号日本海军军法处的电话留言，表示希望将其羁押的8名涉嫌在公共租界犯有扒窃罪的中国男子移交给上海公共租界工部局警务处（S.M.P.）。

获悉上述消息后，高级探员兼主管泰尔弗（Telfer）指派卑职前往该军法处接收上述人员，并将其带至虹口捕房，名单如下：-

5. 王长根（Wong Tsung Kong），39岁，江苏人，男/无业，住索伯恩路索伯恩里13号。
6. 杨金生（Yang Kying Sung），20岁，河北人，单/无业，住法租界。
7. 宋玉林（Song Yon Ling），19岁，乍兴(音译)人，单/无业，住法租界。
8. 孙国荣（Sung Kong Yung），16岁，张州(音译)人，单/无业，住索伯恩路12号。

由警佐上冈（Ueoka，刑事侦探组171号）及卑职进行调查。

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION

    Mr. E. Tachizaki, a Procurator of the above Court,
stated that the 8 accused were arrested by the Naval
Authorities on diverse dates between 2/12/39 and 9/12/39,
and were detained under his custody for preliminary
enquiries. The Procurator expressed his understanding
that the 8 accused handed over to the station be dealt
with in accordance with law governing by the S.S.D. Court.

    On being questioned at the station, all the
accused admitted having committed pocket-picking cases
mostly in Hongkew area, and they further added that they
all had previous convictions on the same offence, ranging
one to six convictions.

    In view of the foregoing the 8 accused will be
arraigned before the S.S.D. Court on the morning of
27/12/39 when it will be requested that they be placed
under Writ of Detention for enabling detectives to
complete enquiries and to locate complainants.

    上述法院检察官立崎（E. Tachizaki）先生称，这8名被告于1939年12月2日至12月9日期间在不同日期被海军当局逮捕，并由其羁押以进行初步讯问。检察官表示理解，移交至捕房的8名被告将依据特别市政法庭（S.S.D. Court）管辖的法律进行处理。

    在捕房接受讯问时，所有被告均承认主要在虹口地区犯下扒窃案件，并进一步补充说，他们此前均因同一罪行被判刑，判刑次数从一次到六次不等。

    鉴于上述情况，这8名被告将于1939年12月27日上午在特别市政法庭受审，届时将请求签发拘留令，以便探员完成调查并寻找报案人。

With reference to the remarks of D.C. (Crime),
the undersigned visited Sub-lieutenant Morimoto at
the Settlement Defence Force of the Japanese Naval
Landing Party stationed on Namsan Road, at 11 a.m.
August 8, 1930. Regarding the handing over of the
person in question the officer stated as follows:

In all cases, the Japanese Naval Landing
Party has been willing to co-operate with the S.M.
Police as far as possible; and from this point of
view the armed robber who had been arrested in the
Honghew area by the Japanese Naval Landing Party the
other day was very easily handed into the custody
of Honghew Station of the S.M.Police.

In compliance with the verbal request made
by Honghew Station, they readily agreed to hand
over the prisoner in question, as hitherto, and for
the sake of mutual convenience. But in the ensuing
negotiation with the officer concerned in Honghew
Station regarding the transfer of a copy of state-
ment of the prisoner made by a S.M.Police staff and
permission of interviewing him in case of necessity
for questioning, the officer concerned stated that
he had no authorities to take up the above-mentioned
matter verbally and suggested that they send an

关于刑事科副主任的意见，卑职于1930年8月8日上午11时，在南山路的日本海军陆战队租界防卫队驻地拜访了森本（Morimoto）少尉。关于移交涉案人员一事，该军官陈述如下：

在所有情况下，日本海军陆战队一直愿意尽可能与上海公共租界警务处合作；从这个角度来看，日前由日本海军陆战队在虹口地区逮捕的那名武装抢劫犯，非常顺利地移交给了上海公共租界警务处虹口捕房羁押。

应虹口捕房的口头请求，他们像以往一样，为了双方方便，欣然同意移交该名囚犯。但在随后与虹口捕房有关官员就移交一份由上海公共租界警务处人员制作的囚犯供词副本，以及在必要时允许面谈以进行讯问的事宜进行谈判时，有关官员表示他无权口头处理上述事项，并建议就此向警务处处长发送一封

of Police from the Senior Officer of the Japanese

Despite the co-operation and sincerity on
the part of the Japanese Naval Landing Party in
simplicity, the S.M. Police made the allegation to
complicate matters.

In view of the foregoing, the Japanese Naval
Landing Party felt indisposed to give facilities
to the S.M. Police and decided to take steps for
the disposal of the prisoner at their will.

Time at which investigation begun and concluded each day
Places visited in course of investigation each day

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

Since this crime had been committed on many occasions the J.L.Party was communicated with, but every time the detectives were told that their (J.L.I) investigations not completed yet, therefore the arrested man could not be handed over to the S.M.P. Eventually on 20/7/39, D.S. Suga was informed by the member of J.L.I. investigating the case that the arrested man would be disposed of by the J.L.I. and not be handed over to the S.M.P.

Efforts were made to ascertain the reason for not handing over and as to how the culprit was disposed of, but such informations were refused by the J.L.I. On 24/7/39, Moh Sie Ling, the man who had arrested the culprit (see diary 1) came to the station and stated that on 18/7/39, one Chinese employed by the Telephone Company call at his house and informed him that he (Moh Sie Ling) entitled for a reward from the Company for such arrest and told him to report this case to the Company's office, Fokien Road. Moh attended and was received by a foreigner who told him that the reward only would be issued if confirmation of the arrest be received by them from the S.M.P. It is respectfully suggested that required confirmation be forwarded to the Shanghai Telephone Company. The case respectfully forwarded for classification.

D.D.C. 'C'.
Sen.Det. i/c.
Sgd: D.S.I. Beloshenko.

由于此罪案多次发生，曾与日本陆战队（J.L.Party）联系，但每次探员都被告知他们的（日本陆战队情报部门 J.L.I）调查尚未完成，因此被捕男子无法移交给上海公共租界警务处。最终在1939年7月20日，负责调查此案的日本陆战队情报部门成员通知警佐须贺（Suga），被捕男子将由日本陆战队情报部门自行处置，不会移交给上海公共租界警务处。

曾努力查明不予移交的原因以及罪犯是如何被处置的，但日本陆战队情报部门拒绝提供此类信息。1939年7月24日，逮捕该罪犯的男子莫西林（Moh Sie Ling，见日志1）来到捕房，称1939年7月18日，一名受雇于电话公司的中国人到访其家中，告知他（莫西林）有权因该次逮捕获得公司奖励，并让他向福建路的公司办公室报告此事。莫氏前往并受到一名外侨接待，该外侨告知他，只有当他们收到上海公共租界警务处对逮捕行为的确认后，才会发放奖励。谨建议将所需的确认函发送至上海电话公司。本案谨呈请分类归档。

“C”区刑事副主任。
主管高级探员。
签名：警佐别洛申科（D.S.I. Beloshenko）。

Remarks
(Any outstanding or peculiar features commented on by investigating officer)

At 12.45 p.m. 9/7/39, one V.K. Vasilieff,
supervisor employed by the Shanghai Telephone Co.
came to the station and reported that a length of
lead covered telephone cable (approx: 50 feet) had
been cut in Lane 36 off Kashing Road. He also
reported that the thief or thieves were apparently
disturbed as the cable had not been taken away.

The scene of crime was visited by C.J.C.387
and the undersigned and enquiries were made during
which one named Yoh Sie Ling ( ) shop-assistant
residing House 1, Lane 36 off Kashing Road was
located and he stated that he had arrested the thief.

He was questioned and the following particulars
were ascertained:-

Yoh Sie Ling is residing in same alleyway where
the cable was cut and at about 2.30 a.m. 9/7/39 he
was awakened by a noise in the alleyway. On leaning
from the window he observed two male Chinese busy in
cutting the telephone cable. Yoh called one of his
friends in the house and went into the alleyway. On
seeing them one of the culprits rushed away and made
good his escape along Kashing Rd. The second culprit
who was on the ladder cutting the cable gave a
resistence but eventually was arrested by the witness
and handed over to the nearest sentry of the Japanese
Naval Landing Party who also took the ladder as well.

The J.N.L.Party was visited by D.P.S. 841
Shinokawa who was informed that as their enquiries
are not completed yet the arrested man would probably
be handed over to the S.M.P. sometime in the afternoon

备注
（调查警官评论的任何突出或特殊特征）

1939年7月9日下午12时45分，上海电话公司雇员主管 V.K. Vasilieff 来到捕房报案，称嘉善路36弄有一段铅包电话电缆（约：50英尺）被切断。他还报告说，窃贼似乎受到了惊扰，因为电缆未被带走。

刑事司法协调员387号（C.J.C.387）及卑职走访了犯罪现场并进行查询，期间找到一名名叫姚西林（Yoh Sie Ling）（ ）的店员，住在嘉善路36弄1号，他声称自己逮捕了窃贼。

经讯问，查得以下详情：-

姚西林居住在电缆被切断的同一条弄堂内，1939年7月9日凌晨2时30分左右，他被弄堂里的噪音吵醒。他从窗口探身观察，看到两名中国男子正在忙着切割电话电缆。姚叫醒了屋内的一位朋友，然后进入弄堂。罪犯们看到他们后，其中一人逃跑，沿嘉善路逃脱。另一名站在梯子上切割电缆的罪犯进行了抵抗，但最终被证人逮捕，并移交给最近的日本海军陆战队哨兵，该哨兵也收走了梯子。

警督篠川（Shinokawa，841号）走访了日本海军陆战队，得知由于其调查尚未完成，被捕男子可能会在当天下午某个时候移交给上海公共租界警务处
